Polynomial from Sum and Product, Class 10 board exam: zeroes have sum −1/4 and product 1/4.

• p(x) = k[x² − (sum)x + product]
• Sum −1/4: x² + (1/4)x + 1/4
• Take k = 4 to clear fractions: 4x² + x + 1
